page_title: FUL 3-0 BHA | Fulham v Brighton 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

90+1' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Bobby De Cordova-Reid slips the ball through to Adama Traore (Fulham), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:0.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' None of the Brighton players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
89' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) replaces Sasa Lukic.

87' A rebound falls to Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) who knows what to do with it. He drills a low shot from the edge of the penalty box, but Bernd Leno anticipates his intention and denies him with a nice quick save.
86' Simon Adingra (Brighton) is flagged for offside.
84' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adama Traore (Fulham) replacing Harry Wilson.
84' Here comes a substitution. Armando Broja (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Rodrigo Muniz.
81' Harry Wilson (Fulham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
80' A cross from a corner kick by Brighton is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
79' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) is angry with himself. The ball breaks to him but he hits the right post!
78' Substitution. Carlos Baleba walks off the pitch and Jakub Moder (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.
77' Brighton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Carlos Baleba (Brighton) who loops his header high over the bar.
71' The referee blows his whistle after Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
69' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Andreas Pereira will be replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
69' The game has come to an end for Alex Iwobi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Willian (Fulham).
68' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

68' What a great touch by Harry Wilson (Fulham) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Now Fulham have a corner.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.

62' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Evan Ferguson (Brighton) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Bernd Leno pulls off a brilliant save.

62' A sweet pass finds Andreas Pereira (Fulham) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Jason Steele is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
61' What a big chance! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
59' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Lewis Dunk is replaced by Pascal Gross (Brighton).
59' Substitution. Adam Lallana leaves the pitch and is replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton).
59' Adam Lallana slides a brilliant pass into Evan Ferguson (Brighton), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
57' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Simon Hooper ignores the protests.
54' The opposition can't get near Andreas Pereira (Fulham), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second.
53' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
53' Simon Adingra (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Brighton have a corner.
52' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in.
52' Corner kick. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
51' Harry Wilson (Fulham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fulham.
51' Flag up against Evan Ferguson (Brighton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
50' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Harry Wilson (Fulham), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
47' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
47' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

47' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Brighton will take a corner.
46' Roberto De Zerbi has made a change at the break. Simon Adingra has come on in place of Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a half-time substitution. Ansu Fati comes on in place of Julio Enciso (Brighton).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Adam Lallana (Brighton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
43' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
41' The ball possession at the moment is 30:70.
40' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
39' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) picks up an injury.
38' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

37' Julio Enciso (Brighton) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
37' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simon Hooper no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to Brighton.
35' Julio Enciso (Brighton) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.

32' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Harry Wilson and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 2:0.
30' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simon Hooper saw the whole situation.
28' Great solo effort from Julio Enciso (Brighton)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post.

26' What a chance that is! Adam Lallana (Brighton) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
21' Harry Wilson (Fulham) collects a good pass and blasts the ball from medium range into the top left corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
18' Harrison Reed (Fulham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
17' Simon Hooper couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Evan Ferguson (Brighton) and blew his whistle.
13' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
11' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) brings his opponent down. Simon Hooper has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Harrison Reed (Fulham) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot to the top of the net, but the keeper denies him.
8' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Carlos Baleba (Brighton) for a tough tackle.
7' Harry Wilson (Fulham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
3' Julio Enciso (Brighton) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Bernd Leno.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Brighton will have the kick-off.
Simon Hooper will officiate today.
